### PR Category
<!-- Feature, Bug fix, Cleanup, Documentation, or Test Only. -->

### Summary
<!-- Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Name the affected plugins or
     skills. Link related issues with Closes #, Fixes #, or Relates to #. -->

### Validation
<!-- List commands and results, including relevant manual checks and environment.
     State which checks were not run. For plugin changes, check package sync,
     matching version bumps in both manifests, and the Python test suite. -->

### Notes for reviewers
<!-- Call out dependencies, installation or permission changes, and areas needing
     close review. For imported material, identify the source/revision and any
     updates to attribution, license notices, and source manifests. -->
